purpose: One bounded post-closeout attempt to recover leakage-safe historical usability when exact first-publication time is missing but a later independent source can prove the exact row/report was public by a specific date.

acceptableProofs: exact Wayback capture of the official regulator report/viewer page
official regulator record proving the exact containing report was filed or published by a specific date
immutable official artifact demonstrably containing the exact row

stopRule: After one bounded proof sweep and one expanded public-source rotation, freeze remaining historical gaps unless a concrete new source or correctness defect appears.
